parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

• If you do not configure this parameter or if you set this parameter to a value less than 20, the default value is 20.

• If you set this parameter to a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-node-groups --node-group-id ng-ec3c96ff0aa4c60d --next-token a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe4 --cluster-id i119982311660892626523 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller ListNodeGroups --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe4 --ClusterId i119982311660892626523 --NodeGroupId 'ng-ec3c96ff0aa4c60d' --MaxResults 20
